steps.content:
10:30, October 24, N.F. 114
Chief's Office
After four months, you hear news about the DisSea once again.
<color=#fb9259>Schorl</color>: The Illusory Moon tide is about to rise again. After four challenging operations, humanity seizes the initiative this time.

<color=#fb9259>Schorl</color>: It is confirmed that the DisSea Expedition Team did break through the convoluted outskirt of the dead zone. Traversing perils, they reached the Maria City ruins, where the Perishing Star descended, and established an enduring research base there.

<color=#fb9259>Schorl</color>: During the fourth investigation, our Observatorium retrieved crucial timespace coordinates by tracking Chief ${PlayerName}. It turned out that the current tide's epicenter lies unprecedentedly near the heart of the DisSea.

<color=#fb9259>Schorl</color>: Soon, we will be following in the pioneers' footsteps, tracing their lost research findings with the chance to uncover truths entombed within the dead zone.

<color=#fb9259>Schorl</color>: MBCC Chief ${PlayerName}, the shackles bearer, will continue to lead the charge with backing from all departments.

<color=#fb9259>Schorl</color>: In addition, the following modification will be implemented to our approach this time:

<color=#fb9259>Schorl</color>: During the last Illusory Moon tide, ${PlayerName}'s connection to the Moon was further intensified. Once the tide reaches its climax, ${PlayerName}'s mind would inevitably connect with the Black Ring, resulting in direct consciousness contact with the Mania illusion and triggering severe mental contamination.

<color=#fb9259>Schorl</color>: Though we cannot completely block the influence of the Illusory Moon, we can reduce its risk coefficient, hence converting this perilous link into a controlled tool and gaining a chance to probe deeper.

<color=#fb9259>Schorl</color>: Over the past five months, the Ring Research Institute has developed a safety protocol:

<color=#fb9259>Schorl</color>: By limiting the shackles' activity, we can suppress the Illusory Moon's corruptive influence on the investigator, thereby safeguarding ${PlayerName}'s sanity.
<color=#fb9259>Schorl</color>: Furthermore, separate researches have also managed to mitigate the risks from restricted shackles use:

<color=#fb9259>Schorl</color>: The Mania beings that emerged during each contamination peak, formerly identified as contamination sources, have now been revealed as echoes of the expedition members who perished in the dead zone. Their consciousness melded with the Mania, reawakening whenever ${PlayerName} returns to the DisSea.

<color=#fb9259>Schorl</color>: While the underlying mechanism remains unverified, and we cannot rule out the possibility of this being a trap orchestrated by the Black Ring, there is one certainty—

<color=#fb9259>Schorl</color>: Every time ${PlayerName} falls prey to mental contamination and ensnared by the DisSea, these entities would attempt to guide ${PlayerName} back to reality.

<color=#fb9259>Schorl</color>: Therefore, as long as ${PlayerName} makes contact with a contamination source, even if ${PlayerName} faces a crisis afterward, we can utilize the source's coordinates to rescue ${PlayerName}'s consciousness in time.
<color=#fb9259>Schorl</color>: In other words, the very people you seek, Chief ${PlayerName}, are your safety net.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...This tide's contamination source is closer than ever to the heart of the Black Ring, you said?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Correct. It is remarkably close to the impact site of the Perishing Star. Essentially, the intelligence we could gather this time might be groundbreaking—we may finally uncover the truth about the Perishing Star.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I understand, and I will do it. There's just one more thing I need to ask...

options: Is there any possibility of bringing them back?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Given our current research findings, we can only guarantee the safe return of your consciousness. As for retrieving anything from the Mania of nearly a century ago, there have been no successful cases so far.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I regret to inform you that the closer those explorers got to the epicenter, the lower their survival chances became. This may not sound rational, but...

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Just think of it as a dream, Chief.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Your task in the DisSea is to address the anomalies, collect intelligence, and uncover information about the expedition. Changing the past is no walk in the park.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: From the very beginning, they chose a path of no return. They marched bravely to their end, gambling everything for even the faintest glimmer of hope and possibility in the darkness.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Their expedition has become history, whereas your expedition is to venture through that history to reclaim the lost possibility.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...I see.
While the words are conveyed in Schorl's typically mechanical manner, you somehow discern a trace of that man's presence within.

14:30, October 24, N.F. 114
Observatorium
An Observatorium staff member leads you to a room filled with an array of scientific instruments.
According to them, the protective equipment in this room can effectively shield your mind during the tide—a far more reliable method than previous attempts.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Chief, everything's set.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Okay.
Following the researcher’s instructions, you lie down and watch as equipment emitting a blue glow slowly descends.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Your expedition is to venture through that history to reclaim the lost possibility.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Let's get started.
After a few minutes, your consciousness starts to blur. Your eyes gradually shut as you slip into a boundless dream.
